title: Huwe Shaheed Ghareeb ul Watan Imam e Raza_
body:
Huwe shaheed ghareeb ul watan imam e Raza.
Tadap ke rooti hai phir rooh e Fatima zahra.
1. Tamam chahane walay ye rooke kehtay hain.
Taqi ke sar se utha haye baap ka saaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jahan may gham ki ghata chaagayi hai charo taraf.
Charagh aathwa gul hogaya imamat ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Pilaya zeher jo mamoon ne huwa ye asar.
Jigar ke tukde huway or tadap gaye moula.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bapa tha shahre qurasaan may jaa baja matam.
Watan se aayi thi bhai se milne masooma.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Nahi hai aap ka bhai lahad hai bhai ki.
Qabarvye sunte hii ghash khaa ke girgayi dukhiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Quda naseeb kare jald wo bhi dinn humko.
Kamal jaake yeh mashhad may hum padhe nouha.
Azz: Mohsin kamaal.
